title: Adversarial Online Classification with a Preview
abstract: arXiv:2608.29503v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Worst-case online classification is governed by sequential complexity, such as Littlestone dimension, and can be impossible even for statistically simple classes, such as thresholds of VC dimension one. We study a preview model in which an oblivious adversary fixes an entire labeled sequence of length $T$, a uniformly random subset of size $pT$ is revealed before prediction begins, and the remaining $(1-p)T$ examples are then presented in their original adversarial order. translated_title: 带预览的对抗性在线分类
translated_abstract: 最坏情况下的在线分类由序贯复杂度（如Littlestone维数）所支配，即使对于统计上简单的类别（如VC维为1的阈值类）也可能无法实现学习。我们研究一种预览模型：一个非自适应对手预先固定整个长度为 $T$ 的带标签序列，在预测开始之前均匀随机地揭示其中大小为 $pT$ 的子集，其余 $(1-p)T$ 个样本随后按其原始的对抗顺序依次呈现。针对在未揭示样本上评估的最优全序列假设，我们刻画了最优超额损失对预览率 $p$ 的依赖关系：对于VC维为 $d$ 的二分类类别，最优超额损失为 $\Theta(d/p+\sqrt{dT})$（至多以平凡上限 $T$ 为界）；对于多分类类别，我们得到相应的 $\widetilde O(d_{\rm DS}/p+\sqrt{d_{\rm Nat}T})$ 界，且不依赖于标签数量。因此，随机预览可以取代最坏情况下的序贯复杂度（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出带随机预览的对抗性在线分类模型，证明提前随机揭示比例为 $p$ 的样本可使最优超额损失达到 $\Theta(d/p+\sqrt{dT})$，从而用随机预览消除了对Littlestone维数等最坏情况序贯复杂度的依赖，使统计上简单的类别变得可学习。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an adversarial online classification model with a random preview, proving that revealing a random $p$-fraction of examples beforehand yields optimal excess loss $\Theta(d/p+\sqrt{dT})$, thereby replacing worst-case sequential complexity (such as the Littlestone dimension) with a random preview.
